Sleep Music | Relaxing Music with Bansuri | 1 Hour

When sleep won't come and the mind won't quiet — try this. The body remembers how to rest.

One unbroken hour of ancient Indian bamboo flute playing Raga Darbari, tuned to 432Hz healing frequency, with a subliminal Delta wave layer that signals the body it's safe to fall.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- the Bansuri (a bamboo flute with a breathy, meditative tone)
- 432Hz — classic healing frequency tuned to natural harmony
- A subliminal Delta wave entrainment layer
- Seamless loops with smooth crossfades throughout

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling
7:00   Drift begins
30:00   Deep delta
49:00   Gentle return

🧠 How to use:
Play at low volume from a phone or speaker by your bed. Don't watch the screen. Within 20–30 minutes, the music loops you into sleep.

⏱ Best for:
• Falling asleep
• Insomnia relief
• Night-time wind-down
• Pre-sleep meditation
